searchText: Does anyone in this channel that’s hates mining even know anything about it? It’s all FUD. Why is anyone upset someone else is making money. No one would be apart of eth if they didn’t believe it had value I'm going to start removing comments around mining fud/hate/etc from this channel as they are off topic. The merge topic is about r&d related to transitioning from pow to pos. This concerns primarily the software development to get to the upgrade and minor spec changes/fixes in the queue. quick question.. for shadow forks.. is there a page (like https://kiln.themerge.dev/) that has the links (possibly an associated calendar).... curious which one is next ! thx.. Yes we have similar pages for the shadow forks: https://ethstats.mainnetshadowfork2.ethdevops.io/ but no overview page Regarding timing, we usually make the dates up as we go depending on pari's availability As Tim has already mentioned please read Security Considerations section of EIP-3675 to learn about rationale behind TTD and the upgrade mechanics. Regarding optimistic sync, you may read rationale in this section https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/dev/sync/optimistic.md#design-decision-rationale We're trying to keep rationale for all non-obvious design decisions documented alongside specification; sometimes it's in a separated document, e.g. annotated consensus specs. So, the first step would be seeking for rationale in the spec document itself, and then asking here for clarification or if anything is missed in documentation. Is the plan to include mev boost in merge clients? It won't be "included in" but "compatible with" CL clients. So validators will need to run it in parallel to their EL + CL combo Ty.

I'm going to start removing comments around mining fud/hate/etc from this channel as they are off topic.

excerpts.author: mariusvanderwijden
excerpts.content:
Yes we have similar pages for the shadow forks: https://ethstats.mainnetshadowfork2.ethdevops.io/ but no overview page
Regarding timing, we usually make the dates up as we go depending on pari's availability

excerpts.author: m.kalinin
excerpts.content:
As Tim has already mentioned please read Security Considerations section of EIP-3675 to learn about rationale behind TTD and the upgrade mechanics. Regarding optimistic sync, you may read rationale in this section https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/dev/sync/optimistic.md#design-decision-rationale

We're trying to keep rationale for all non-obvious design decisions documented alongside specification; sometimes it's in a separated document, e.g. annotated consensus specs. So, the first step would be seeking for rationale in the spec document itself, and then asking here for clarification or if anything is missed in documentation.
